question: Which heterogeneous motor resource regimes are monotone, windowed, mixed or infeasible under a fixed time-scale-aware controller?
theory: Heterogeneity is not sufficient for a finite window. Zero mismatch exposure removes the high-participation branch; non-zero exposure can produce a window only when its marginal cost exceeds contraction gain and available control authority.

class_rule.window: an interior point exceeds both endpoints by at least 0.05
class_rule.monotone_non_decreasing: every adjacent success change is at least -0.05

evidence_boundary: prospective computational regime map; parameter regimes are author-declared sensitivity conditions, not independently identified fleets or physical/HIL experiments
